reason: Live bug (run 224d1141, 15:07Z): scheduled-job 'Running' progress card silently dropped because lifecycleGeneration is a hash of a random UUID while every channel progress sink accepts only generations greater than the previous run's sealed one; make the generation strictly monotonic. Scope: scheduler-lifecycle-notification.ts + lifecycle-retirement.test.ts.

residual_risks: A process that sealed a hash-era generation before deploy rejects Date.now()-era values until restart; deploys restart the runtime
quality.summary: Progress-card generation ordering is now sound for every channel sink. Lite window Q-0079 (base bef4b76c -> HEAD): scheduled-job 'Running' progress card silently dropped when a run's hash-derived generation was lower than the previous run's sealed generation on the same chat/thread (live run 224d1141). Fix: strictly monotonic max(Date.now(), last+1). Proof: lifecycle-retirement + execution-notifications + telegram suites 249/249 green, tsc, architecture, verify.py passed; autoreview clean first pass; no other producer of progress generations (grep).

non_blocking_findings.summary: FIXED: random (hash) lifecycle generation vs monotonic sink gate dropped ~half of 'Running' cards
